Evan (sales): Hey team — prepping the Acme POC kickoff tomorrow. Need a quick sync on prompts, success criteria, and any security blockers.
Nora (eng): Thanks. Quick list pls: core use cases, sample prompts, target latency/throughput, and success metrics.
Sam (solutions): Core use cases are: 1) customer support triage (classify & extract), 2) knowledge base answer generation, 3) automated reply suggestions.
Evan (sales): Right — customer said 95% classification accuracy for triage, <500ms median gen latency for small help answers, and 10k tokens/day during trial.
Alex (acct): Pricing question: if usage spikes to 50k tokens/day during demo week, do we need a committed slot or will hosted burst handle it?
Nora (eng): Hosted can burst but recommend enabling a small Dedicated pool for consistent 500ms SLO. For trial, we can use burst + autoscale. I'll note config: `batch_size: auto`, `max_latency_ms: 500`.
Sam (solutions): Prompt inventory draft (examples):
- Triage classify: `System: You are a helpdesk classifier. User: {ticket_text}` -> `Assistant: class: [billing|bug|feature] confidence:`
- Extract entities: `Extract customer, product, error_code from: {ticket_text}`
- KB answer: `Given this KB: {kb_chunks}, answer concisely to: {user_question}`
These are baseline; we should lock temperature=0.0 for deterministic outputs on classification/extract.
Maria (security): Data residency + PII handling? They send real tickets. We need to know retention policy and whether we can enable auto-redaction + KMS. Also ask for their required SOC2 region.
Evan (sales): They are in EU only, must stay in eu-central. Also they asked about encryption at rest + audit logs.
Maria (security): We can enable eu region private deployment (redwood-private). Need to confirm legal review timeline. Also we require customer to sign DPA for logs.
Alex (acct): For pricing, pass-through of dedicated cost? They prefer a short-term monthly commit for predictability. I'll propose a 1-month reserved capacity estimate and option to revert to hosted.
Nora (eng): For evals: propose prompt set of ~200 examples per use case (100 classify, 50 extract, 50 KB QA). Metrics: precision/recall for classify, exact match / F1 for extract, ROUGE-L & human rating for KB answers.
Sam (solutions): Can we add golden prompts + mismatch examples to surface regressions? Also add a simple reranker for KB results: serve top-5, then rerank with cross-encoder.
Evan (sales): Timeline: Day0 kickoff, Day1-3 prompt prep, Day4-7 ingest KB & test harness, Day8-10 evaluation + tweak, Day11 demo to stakeholders. Is that realistic?
Nora (eng): Yes, if we get KB and 200 prompts per use case by EOD Day1. We need sample environment creds for EU region and a contact for networking (for VPC setup).
Maria (security): I'll start the security questionnaire. Quick asks to feed them now: expected data types, retention window, who has access, KMS key ownership, audit log retention.
Alex (acct): I'll draft a short SOW with pricing bands for tokens and optional dedicated pool, and include a clause for demo spike protection.
Evan (sales): Action items: Sam to finalize prompt inventory template; Nora to prepare EU test env and config snippet; Maria to send security checklist; Alex to send SOW draft.
Sam (solutions): Will do — sharing prompt inventory CSV template in this thread in a sec.
infra-bot: deploy job 56981 succeeded (redwood-private eu-central test env provisioned) :rocket:
Nora (eng): Great — infra-bot shows env up. Evan, send them the onboarding form and KB upload link.
Evan (sales): Sent. I'll follow up with the legal contact. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Sam (solutions): One more note — baseline config for deterministic classification:
```
model: open-redwood-mini
temp: 0.0
max_tokens: 64
batching: true
kv_cache: enabled
```
Keep this saved as the POC baseline.
Nora (eng): Saved. We'll instrument cost telemetry and tie to per-route dashboards.
Maria (security): If they need a signed DPA, loop in legal. Also confirm whether logs should be retained beyond 30 days.
Evan (sales): I'll confirm retention. Closing loop after kickoff.
